title: Archcathedral Basilica of St. Peter and St. Paul
visualBrief: Individual Poznań Cathedral:two tall western red-brick towers with narrow lower fields,one front clock,dark oxidized-copper louvered belfry stages and tiered Baroque caps/crosses. Deep pointed central portal/window field beneath stepped Gothic brick gable with slender pale recessed panels. Long buttressed brick nave and green pitched roof;three smaller faceted eastern choir towers with pointed glazing,swelling copper roofs,actual open lanterns and onion/cross tips. Lower pale ambulatory/chapels include projecting green-domed eastern chapel,pilasters,round-headed windows and small supported geometric figures. Five existing shared brick/stone/copper/wood/plaster graphs and four browser levels. Fine sculpture/inscriptions,interiors and surveyed ground/threshold joins simplified or excluded.

nativeAxes.x: east-northeast from twin-tower facade toward faceted choir
